items.summary_en: The Gordie Howe International Bridge between Windsor, Ontario and Detroit, Michigan has officially opened to traffic. The legendary hockey player's grandson drove the first car across the new span. The bridge connects Ontario Highway 401 directly to Interstate 75 in Michigan.

items.raw_excerpt: Isaac del Toro made history as he delivered Mexico’s best result ever in the Tour de France, taking third place overall.
items.summary_en: Isaac del Toro finished third in the Tour de France. This is the best result ever for a Mexican cyclist. He is from the city of Ensenada.

items.raw_excerpt: Often compared with Burgundy, the Australian island’s wines are winning praise for their vivid fruit, bright acidity and distinctive cool-climate character.
items.summary_en: Tasmania is an island in Australia. Its Chardonnay wines are praised for bright fruit and acidity. They are compared to famous Burgundy wines.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite volatile fuel prices and sluggish demand, Vietjet Thailand said the aviation situation remains manageable as it is still ramping up capacity and building a new regional hub in Udon Thani.
items.summary_en: Vietjet Thailand says it is still building a regional hub in Udon Thani despite high fuel prices and low demand. The airline plans to grow its capacity at the new base. The project aims to make Udon Thani a key city for Vietjet in the region.

items.summary_en: Manjimup residents are questioning a proposal to cull wild horses at Lake Muir. They argue that feral pigs are a more urgent problem that needs attention.

items.raw_excerpt: Toronto's fire chief is sounding the alarm over the possible dangers of e-bikes, sharing a video of one catching fire on Sunday morning.
items.summary_en: Toronto's fire chief is warning about the dangers of e-bikes after a video showed one catching fire in a high-rise building on Sunday morning. The fire chief shared the video to raise awareness about the growing number of e-bike fires in the city. Officials are concerned about safety as more people use electric bikes.

items.raw_excerpt: July not only brings Oaxaca's signature cultural festival, Guelaguetza, but several events celebrating its most famous product: mezcal.
items.summary_en: July brings Oaxaca's famous cultural festival Guelaguetza along with several events celebrating mezcal. The mezcal festivals showcase the region's most iconic spirit and its rich tradition. Visitors can taste different mezcals and enjoy local culture in the heart of Oaxaca.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite rising costs, the Thai restaurant industry is expected to continue expanding this year, according to an executive of Central Restaurants Group Co Ltd (CRG).
items.summary_en: The Thai restaurant industry is expected to keep growing this year even as costs go up. An executive from Central Restaurants Group said the industry will continue to expand. Rising expenses have not stopped restaurants from opening new locations.

items.summary_en: Aryna Sabalenka will team up with Novak Djokovic and Iga Swiatek partners with Casper Ruud in the US Open mixed doubles draw. The star-studded pairings lead the initial entry list for the Grand Slam tournament in New York.

items.raw_excerpt: The new system, which has already sparked concern among doctors and some health care advocacy groups, has been in the works for months. It allows Albertans to self-refer and pay for MRIs, CT scans, ultrasounds and X-rays.
items.summary_en: Alberta has introduced a new system allowing residents to self-refer and pay for MRI, CT scans, ultrasounds and X-rays without a doctor's referral. The policy change has raised concerns among doctors and healthcare advocacy groups. The system has been in development for several months.

items.title_en: Alberta residents can now pay for MRI and other scans without doctor referral

items.raw_excerpt: There isn't much left of the RCMP detachment in Morse, Sask., after a hydrant failed during efforts to fight a fire on Sunday. Local farmers and Hutterite colonies offered support to finally extinguish the blaze.
items.summary_en: A fire hydrant failed while crews tried to put out a fire at the RCMP detachment in Morse, Saskatchewan. Local farmers and nearby Hutterite colonies stepped in with water and equipment to finally extinguish the blaze. The police station building was badly damaged.

items.raw_excerpt: Concern is growing in Irish universities over a high rate of refusal of study visas to students in Gaza who are due to take up college scholarships in Ireland this September.
items.summary_en: Irish universities are worried about a high rate of study visa refusals for students from Gaza. These students won scholarships to study at Irish colleges starting this September. The high refusal rate is blocking them from taking up their places.

items.raw_excerpt: A set net ban to protect hoiho off the Otago Peninsula will be made permanent to reduce the risk of fishing bycatch.
items.summary_en: A temporary ban on set fishing nets off the Otago Peninsula has been made permanent to help protect the hoiho, also known as the yellow-eyed penguin. The ban aims to reduce the risk of penguins being caught as fishing bycatch. It is one of several measures to support the survival of this rare native bird.

items.title_en: Permanent ban on set nets to protect rare penguins near Otago Peninsula
